outcome: Depression levels (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale, EPDS)
cohort: 266 Italian women, divided into two groups: those who delivered during the pandemic period (from December 2019) and those who delivered before the pandemic period (until November 2019)
finding: There were no statistically significant differences in GAD and EPDS scores between women who delivered before and during the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: GAD values statistically differed considering the type of birth (P=0.021).
